ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 20,000 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number, so a new buyer has no proof to act on. Print the review count on the creative and open the next ads with a customer quote about taste.

2 of 21 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so the trust a creator builds with their audience is lost behind a logo. Whitelist them from the creator account and cut three variations in the same creator voice.

19 different openings run across 21 ads, and the biggest opens only 2. Most stories appear in one ad, so no hook builds recognition. Pick the two strongest openings, then build three new variations from each for the next batch.
30 ads have run 60 days or more, so your oldest hot brew ad is proven, yet little else is built around it. Build three variations of it, each with a new image and opening line, to reach more buyers.
